info.description: Route coverage for selectielijst, selectielijstReference, Settings\EdepotSettings, transfer, gitHubIssues, flowRun, flowRunMigration, task, taskNotes, taskEvents, portalTask, case and federatedConfig. Each route gets its success path, an unknown-id or invalid-input answer where the controller has one, and for non-admin routes the answer for a non-admin user without rights. Seeds its own data: 00 setup creates a register, schema, object and a non-admin user, stores their ids in collection variables, and 99 teardown deletes them; every folder creates and removes the further fixtures it needs. Depends on no other collection.
